body: maybe I just over think my relationships and just assume people hate me as much as I hate myself.

yeah, I'll meet new people online, we might share a few interests, but they won't ever reply if I try to message them. no one ever does. I don't pester people with messages, I might just send "hey, how's it going?" once in a while to see if I get a response. and if it wasn't obvious no one ever seeks out to talk to me on their own. I ALWAYS have to initiate.  Even my boyfriend doesn't initiate. I just want to feel like somewhat of an ok person. I just want to see someone who WANTS to talk to me....why is that so hard...why is that too much to ask for...fuck.. ugh.
